# ECN-2026-042 Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HP03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-049, MM-P2-L4-HP03, SOP-P2-L4-03

Reason for change
- An update to the hydraulic control architecture for the heat treat station requires formal revision of the operating envelope for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3. The new control module changes the software safety interlocks and requires confirmation of the maximum allowable pressure setting for the press hydraulic system.
- The system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar. This value reflects the validated maximum pressure compatible with existing cylinder seals, hoses, and manifold ratings verified during bench verification referenced in ECN-2026-049.

Affected items
- Hydraulic power unit and pressure relief setpoint on EQ-P2-L4-HP03.
- Control logic configuration and operator interface parameters used by SOP-P2-L4-03.
- Maintenance and inspection criteria in MM-P2-L4-HP03 that reference allowable pressure thresholds and replacement criteria for pressure-loaded components.

Implementation
- Update the pressure setpoint in the control system to reflect the system pressure limit specified above. Confirm the setpoint is locked against operator modification per the change control mechanism.
- Revise SOP-P2-L4-03 to include the confirmed system pressure limit and update the prestart checklist to validate indication and setpoint alignment for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.
- Update MM-P2-L4-HP03 to reference the new pressure limit for inspection acceptance criteria and spares selection for pressure-containing items.
- Perform functional verification on EQ-P2-L4-HP03 after configuration changes and record verification results in accordance with ECN-2026-049.

Approvals
- Engineering authorization required to execute control setpoint updates and document revisions.
- Operations authorization required to accept the updated SOP content for live production use.
- Maintenance authorization required to update MM-P2-L4-HP03 and incorporate inspection changes prior to next scheduled outage.
